POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

# A new order is pending, with one authorization per identifier.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "www.example.org"}]}
$code == 201
$body.status == pending
$body.expires exists
$body.finalize exists
$body.identifiers == [{"type":"dns","value":"example.org"},{"type":"dns","value":"www.example.org"}]
$body.authorizations[1] exists
$body.authorizations[2] !exists
$body.error !exists
capture order = $header.Location
capture expires = $body.expires
capture authz0 = $body.authorizations[0]
capture authz1 = $body.authorizations[1]

POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == pending
$body.expires == $expires
$body.identifiers[1].value == www.example.org

POST-as-GET $authz1
$body.status == pending
$body.expires == $expires
$body.identifier == {"type":"dns","value":"www.example.org"}
$body.wildcard !exists
$body.challenges[0].type == http-01
$body.challenges[0].status == pending
$body.challenges[0].url exists
$body.challenges[0].token ~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22,}$$
$body.challenges[0].validated !exists
$body.challenges[1] !exists

POST-as-GET https://magnolia.test/acme/order/does-not-exist
$code == 404

# Orders and authorizations must not carry a payload.
POST $order
payload {}
error == malformed

POST $authz0
payload {"status": "deactivated"}
error == malformed

# Orders belong to the account that created them.
POST $dir.newAccount as account2
payload {}
$code == 201

POST-as-GET $order as account2
error == unauthorized

POST-as-GET $authz0 as account2
error == unauthorized

# Wildcard identifiers are rendered as the base name with the wildcard flag.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "*.example.org"}]}
$code == 201
$body.identifiers[0].value == *.example.org
capture wildcardAuthz = $body.authorizations[0]

POST-as-GET $wildcardAuthz
$body.identifier.value == example.org
$body.wildcard == true

# Invalid order requests.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {}
error == malformed

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": []}
error == malformed

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}]}
error == malformed

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "192.0.2.1"}]}
error == unsupportedIdentifier

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}], "notBefore": "2000-01-02T00:00:00Z"}
$code == 400
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/unsupportedField

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}], "notAfter": "2000-01-02T00:00:00Z"}
$code == 400
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/unsupportedField

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": "example.org"}
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $dir.newOrder
error == malformed

# Orders expire.
sleep 2h

POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == pending

sleep 2h

POST-as-GET $order
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/orderNotFound

POST-as-GET $authz0
$code == 404
